case.summary: Case CASE-010 (Card SC-03010-K950): The real-time risk model scored transaction 4012172 at 0.89, triggering review [EV-104e2ae8]. Investigation revealed three online transactions on card SC-03010-K950 within 48 hours [EV-0dc0ae34], originating from a new device (Samsung SM-G973F) [EV-4b512881] via an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-da6a2eb7]. The device profile was previously linked to a confirmed fraud case [EV-d5f801bc], and the customer has one prior fraud case (CC-4321) [EV-df76a3be]. The customer denied making the purchases and confirmed card possession [EV-62955f1a]. Six prior cases share the card_not_present_new_device pattern [EV-6e221a09]. The case was closed as fraud with $644.95 exposure across three transactions.

sar.narrative: Suspicious Activity Report for CASE-010 documents a card-not-present fraud pattern involving three transactions totaling $644.95 on card SC-03010-K950. The triggering transaction 4012172 ($269.17) received a risk score of 0.89 and originated from a previously unseen device (Samsung SM-G973F map400 Playlist for Android) [EV-4b512881] connecting through an anonymous proxy IP geolocated to Argentina [EV-da6a2eb7]. Three online transactions occurred within a 48-hour window [EV-0dc0ae34], deviating from the card's historical average of $187.89 per transaction [EV-0ee83989]. The device fingerprint has been associated with a prior confirmed fraud case [EV-d5f801bc], and the customer (SC-03010) has a previous fraud record (CC-4321) [EV-df76a3be]. The cardholder reported no authorization of the transactions and confirmed physical card retention [EV-62955f1a]. Pattern analysis retrieved six prior cases exhibiting the same card_not_present_new_device signature [EV-6e221a09]. The investigation concluded with a fraud verdict and case closure. The activity is consistent with device spoofing and proxy-enabled card-not-present fraud.
